description.value: Tequila Cocina is an authentic Mexican restaurant on the south end of Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, adjacent to the Davie Street entertainment district and close to the SkyTrain. The restaurant offers a lively atmosphere with indoor and outdoor seating, a full bar, and a menu of locally-made Mexican food. Takeout and delivery are also available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the downtown core.
